Approaches are being carried out to eradicate the vector that transmits dengue - City of Concordia Home / News / Approaches are being carried out to eradicate the vector that transmits dengue Noticia 19 de enero de 2024 Approaches are being carried out to eradicate the vector that transmits dengue
 The Primary Health Care Directorate is carrying out tasks in conjunction with other municipal areas to prevent the appearance of and eradicate the Aedes Aegypti vector. 
In accordance with the actions proposed by the area under the Undersecretariat of Health, advice is being provided to the residents of the Ex Aeroclub neighborhood, proceeding to carry out cleaning tasks in homes and surroundings, as well as fumigation.
With the permission of the citizens, homes are entered to survey places prone to collecting water and, consequently, being spaces where eggs are deposited and larvae of Aedes subsequently form. In this sense, the Municipality of Concordia appreciates the willingness of the residents to allow this campaign to be carried out. Photo gallery
